comment: Ms. Reiner wants you to do well, and if you make an effort and talk to her about your concerns.

Love Ms. Reiner!! She is so sweet, and if you take BIOL120, she recognizes that most ppl are seniors/there for the gen-ed credit and makes the course as easy, but also as relevant as possible! Super flexible and makes class fun with jokes and stories! Take her if you can!! Minimal homework + readings.

Ms. Reiner is the kindest professor at Richmond hands down. She understands that this class is full of kids who just need to do the science gen ed and makes it easy bc of that. Quizzes are all open note, on blackboard. 2 presentations (can read right off ur screen), 1 midterm and optional final (can be replaced with midterm exam grade). Highly rec!
Ms Reiner is the goated bio teacher for gen ed. super easy and she knows no one wants to be there so she makes things very simple. she is also hilarious. cannot recommend enough

Very sweet professor!! I was kinda nervous about my science gen ed, but Ms. Reiner's BIOL 120 course is tailored directly to those who only want gen ed credit. She breaks down science-y stuff well! Just give a crap, and be engaged with her assignments/labs, and you'll have a wonderful time. Exams required some effort - so use her study guides!

An incredibly nice prof who wants to see you succeed. You'll get full credit for assignments if you do them. Tests are worth 50% of the grade and are challenging, so be sure to study. Responsive to emails and a great choice for the science gen-ed. Class is very interesting and you certainly learn a lot.
I took her class for the gen ed credit and it was a great decision. While her midterm is somewhat challenging, the rest of the class is extremely easy. She is also a very understanding person

Professor Reiner was awesome. Took her gen ed course after someone recommended her. Great decision. While midterm was difficult, the semester was pretty easy. She's an easy grader on assignments. Day one, understood that we weren't bio majors and there for the gen ed and was super funny and understanding. Doable science gen ed, fun professor.

Actually the kindest prof ive had. Gives you basically as many chances as you want as long as you go to her with any problems you have. So understanding and literally wants to help your grade/GPA. If you have the opportunity take her because she is just a kind person. Lecture isnt the most interesting just try to stay awake. Very good

Reiner is the perfect professor to take to get your gen ed requirement for science. Very clear about what's on the tests and homework and assignments are clearly outlined. She grades assignments based on completion, not accuracy and she is very lenient and understanding of students. Her class was a cakewalk but it's also pretty interesting.

Took Prof. Reiner's Bio 199 Infectious Disease course. Lectures are somewhat disorganized, but follow the PowerPoints for the tests and you will get an A. The class has a light workload and any assignments given have clear instructions and feedback attached. She is nice, approachable, and wants her students to do well. Definitely recommend!

Professor Reiner is a fantastic introductory biology teacher. She explains everything you need to know for the tests and allows you to use her PowerPoints to study. This makes the course overall really easy. I found this class to be an easy A from a fantastic professor. She is very passionate about what she teaches.

She's a bit unconventional and a lot of this is just review for basic biology. She's an easy grader and very understanding for assignments, her tests are essentially what change your grade in the class

Maren Reiner is a kind person who lacks a clear structure when she teaches. The powerpoints are all over the place and her test questions are confusing rather than difficult. You do not have to do the readings. You will get 100% on all of the assignments. Memorize all of the colored powerpoints and you will get a high A in this class.

Great professor, really sweet and kind. Class is easy, just follow the directions on assignments and you'll get full credit. Gives extensions and accommodations if you ask. For exams, she tells you what to study and the exams are pretty easy if you study. Textbook isn't needed, I never bought it and did fine.

Incredibly kind woman, SO nice- can't stress enough. The kind of teacher you can make meaningful small talk with. Homework isn't crazy, and there are no quizzes. If you try on the labs you will guarantee a decent grade. Study powerpoints more than lecture notes for tests. She is always willing to help you, and obviously wants students to succeed.
Really nice teacher. Take for your Science credit!

Extremely nice and helpful. If you have any problems she will go out of her way to try and help you. Class is easy but it is necessary to study for the two tests. Overall, excellent to take for an intro course.

She's a sweet lady and tries her best to make a 9:45AM lecture interesting.  The only reason I did poorly was my horrible attendance record (in which I happened to miss a whole test!) and not having enough money to buy the book (ergo, lack of studying).

VERY nice woman but don't be fooled--not an easy grader. Talks too much during labs but you gotta sit through them-it's prob the same for evey science class.  Bottom Line:really nice but grading almost unfair

hands down nicest woman i have ever met. so pleasant and wonderful. she loves to say "et cetera" A LOT. her class is easy if you put in the time to read the book. all class notes are posted online- huge bonus! take her to fulfill the science requirement, you won't regret it!
Must take this class. Mrs. Reiner is awesome and the class isn't too hard, but very interesting!
